There are multiple versions of this mob with the same name for different purposes:

==== [[Concussion]] Spell Quest ====

* Hampton, a human skeleton, is located along the zone wall of [[Trakanon's Teeth]] location {{Loc|Trakanon's Teeth|270, -3800}}. Hand him the correct bottle to receive a [[Bottle of Swirling Smoke]], which identifies as Hampton's Soul. He is friendly and you can do this hand-in by yourself.

* Ryla, a human skeleton, is located in a jail cell in [[Karnor's Castle]] just south of the "hand" room. Loc is {{Loc|Karnor's Castle|100,-590, 38}}. Give the correct bottle to the skeleton to receive a [[Bottle of Swirling Smoke]], which identifies as Ryla's Soul. He is KoS and you will need an enchanter or necromancer to charm him before you can do the turn-in.
** This version is on VS faction, not necessarily KoS.
** From zone-in, run all the way back and go left (into room 5). Take the stairs in room 5 up top and head north to the castle edge (room 7). Turn right and run all the way back to the wall, turn right, past room 10 (hands), then left and right again at the corner. Half way down this hallway to your right are the jail cells. He is in the second cell on the right. 

* Mardon, a human skeleton, is located in the [[City of Mist]] at location {{Loc|City of Mist|136, -641, 77}}. Give the correct bottle to the skeleton to receive a [[Bottle of Swirling Smoke]], which identifies as Mardon's Soul. He is KoS and you will need an enchanter or necromancer to charm him before you can do the turn-in.
** He does NOT spawn near the brewing barrel on P99.

==== [[Ranger Epic Quest]] & [[Druid Epic Quest]] ====

* (Name?), a human skeleton, is located in the [[Frontier Mountains]] at location {{Loc|Frontier Mountains|-265, -572, 67}} outside the giant fort along the western wall. Give the [[Wood Painting]] to the skeleton to receive a [[Silver Chained Locket]]. It is for the Ranger and Druid Epic Quests. When handed the Painting, the following text occurs: "a human skeleton begins to crack and disintegrate, its body collapsing into a pile of dust that scatters into the winds. On the ground you notice a locket on a fine, thin chain which you pick up."
